title: Workstations
description: Manage remote workstation connections (SSH, Docker) for agents to execute commands.
emptyDescription: Add a workstation to allow agents to run commands on remote machines.

createDialog.title: Add Workstation
createDialog.description: Configure a new remote workstation connection.
createDialog.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Used by agents to reference this workstation.
createDialog.privateKeyPlaceholder: Paste the private key in PEM format
createDialog.privateKeyHint: Stored encrypted. The key content is never returned to the browser.
createDialog.passwordHint: Stored encrypted. Prefer private-key authentication when possible.

errors.sshHostUserRequired: Host and SSH user are required.
errors.sshPortRange: SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.sshPrivateKeyRequired: Paste a private key or choose password authentication.
errors.sshPasswordRequired: Enter the SSH password or choose private-key authentication.
errors.dockerContainerRequired: Container name or ID is required.

editDialog.title: Edit {{name}}
editDialog.description: Update connection details and whether agents may use this workstation.
editDialog.activeHint: Inactive workstations reject new command executions.
editDialog.secretHint: Leave blank to preserve the stored credential. Existing credentials are never displayed.

errors.sshHostUserRequired: Host and SSH user are required.
errors.sshPortRange: SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.dockerContainerRequired: Container name or ID is required.

grants.title: Assign agents to {{name}}
grants.description: Only assigned agents can execute commands on this workstation.
grants.defaultHint: Use this workstation when the agent does not specify a target.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Workstation
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

permissions.title: Command Permissions
permissions.policyDescription: Commands are denied unless the executable matches an enabled exact or prefix pattern below.
permissions.patternHint: Use an executable name or a trailing-prefix pattern. Paths, shell operators, and wildcard-all (*) are not allowed.
permissions.emptyDescription: All workstation commands are denied until an allowlist entry is added.
permissions.invalidPattern: Enter an executable name or trailing-prefix pattern such as python*. Wildcard-all is not allowed.

contactAccess.title: Contact Access
contactAccess.policyDescription: A command runs only when the exact requesting Contact and the Agent are assigned to this workstation, and the executable is allowed. Merged Contacts do not share this grant.
contactAccess.emptyDescription: Every request is rejected until its exact Contact is explicitly allowed.
contactAccess.noAvailableContacts: No matching unassigned Contacts are available.
contactAccess.contactRequired: Select at least one Contact from the list.
contactAccess.partialFailure: Allowed {{succeeded}} of {{total}} Contacts. {{failed}} failed and remain selected for retry.

activity.title: Recent Activity
activity.emptyDescription: Exec events will appear here once agents run commands.
